claim: Measure directional local-process latency overhead of deterministic allocation and verification modes without making a funded execution or network-latency claim.
independentUnit: one complete local candidate construction and configured verifier path
deterministicHardChecks: proposal identity, adapter hash, expiry, and market-root binding
channel, oracle, action, capital, leverage, delta, loss, drawdown, order, slippage, and fee limits
repetitions: iterations estimate local timing distributions and do not increase independent task sample size
uncertaintyRule: Report local-process-only reliability and do not extrapolate omitted stages.
escalationRule: Any deterministic hard-check failure rejects the mode result regardless of latency.
effectThreshold: No release threshold; p50, p95, and p99 are descriptive.
reliabilityLimit: One machine, one process, one verifier implementation, scripted state.
operationalDecisionRule: Continue candidate-only shadow testing. No mode becomes execution-eligible from this benchmark.
